# Writing Fragments Skill for Muse

This is the explore phase before any structure: Muse interviews you relentlessly about what you want to write, mining "fragments" — sharp sentences, claims with one-line justifications, vignettes, half-thoughts, quotes, complaints, confessions — into a single running document with no outline imposed. It even pushes you to coin a "leading word": one compact metaphor the whole piece can hang on. Discovered via skills.sh. Beta note: this skill lives in the author's experimental in-progress folder, so treat it as a promising beta. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
